newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate closes higher, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate closes higher, seen stable.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate finished higher on Friday despite the central bank's continued injection of funds to ease tight liquidity, but dealers said the rate might stabilise next week.

The interbank rate ended at 6.319 percent against Thursday's 6.150 close, with 30-day commercial paper stable at 6.50. Dealers said that over the past two days the central bank had injected T$37.105 billion in funds into the banking system through open market operations.
In the bond market, the seven-year 83/2 government bond yield was at 5.51. -- Julie Hu (2-5080815)
